title: AcademicImprovementCandidateContract
description: Contract schema for unpromoted behavioral improvement candidates targeting agent system prompts, skill scripts, or heuristic rules.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for this improvement candidate (e.g. CAND-2026-CH4-TYPO-001).

target_component.description: Relative file path of the component targeted for modification (e.g. .agents/agents/academic-writer/agent.md, .agents/skills/apa-reporting/SKILL.md).

parent_version.description: Current active version hash or git commit of the targeted component.

content.description: Unified diff text or replacement content representing the exact proposed change.

rationale.description: Attribution and explanation of why this specific mutation resolves the underlying defect.

affected_capabilities.description: List of system capabilities impacted by this candidate mutation.

author_agent.description: Diagnostician or orchestrator agent proposing this candidate (e.g. academic-challenger, statistical-auditor).

associated_pitfall_id.description: Reference to pitfall in state/pitfalls.jsonl motivating this candidate.

target_skill.description: Identifier of the target skill being improved (e.g. statistical-data-analyst, chapter-4-writing).

mutation_type.description: Taxonomy of behavioral mutation applied in this candidate.

source_lessons.description: List of lesson identifiers motivating this candidate improvement.

expected_benefit.description: Detailed explanation of the expected behavioral improvement and defect resolution.

possible_downside.description: Potential risks, side effects, token overhead, or edge cases introduced by this mutation.

testable_hypothesis.description: Empirical scientific hypothesis testable against the evaluation lab (e.g. If the skill includes a model comparison decision tree, the agent will achieve 0% missing reasoning failures on repeated measures tasks).

pareto_rank.description: Pareto rank in multi-dimensional evolutionary search.

evaluation_verdicts.description: Deterministic evaluation results and pass rates from test suites.
